goal.objective: Start the canonical StegVerse resident heartbeat carrier directly as a native engine_v13 oscillator-phase-driven process with no WorkerCoordinator startup prerequisite and no third-party dependency; preserve WorkerCoordinator as a separate downstream task-control process and preserve TV/TVC-only credential authority.
success_predicates: The canonical native carrier process is started under the admitted resident runtime host.
Heartbeat production mode is OSCILLATOR_PHASE_DRIVEN with a 10 ms / 100 Hz oscillator reference.
Starting the carrier requires no prior heartbeat observation, live-proof receipt, WorkerCoordinator start, worker claim, worker fence, or worker lease.
Carrier startup grants no task, claim, fence, credential, route, model, wallet, merge, release, or deployment authority.
GitHub Actions, GitHub tokens, Render, and other third-party process hosts are not production heartbeat authority.
No network fetch or third-party scheduler/deployment/process host is required.
failure_predicates: Startup is gated on HEARTBEAT-INDEPENDENT-OSCILLATOR-LIVE-009 completion.
Startup is gated on WorkerCoordinator execution or a worker claim/fence/lease.
WorkerCoordinator, a repository event, workflow event, task, claim, fence, or observer becomes heartbeat timing authority.
The native carrier cannot become active on the admitted resident host.
A GitHub token or non-TV/TVC credential becomes runtime authority.
A third-party process host, scheduler, deployment service, or network fetch becomes required.
authority_ceiling: materialize and start canonical sovereign heartbeat carrier native service

task.derivation_reason: Heartbeat startup and heartbeat live proof were previously conflated, and the combined native installer unnecessarily started WorkerCoordinator alongside the carrier. The oscillator carrier can and should start directly first; worker runtime remains a separate downstream lane and post-start proof verifies the already-running carrier.

activation.bootstrap_semantics: On the admitted resident StegVerse host, execute the carrier-only installer directly. It materializes the runtime locally, registers only the carrier with the native OS process supervisor, starts engine_v13 continuously from oscillator phase, and writes carrier-activation.latest.json. WorkerCoordinator is not started by this path and remains a separate downstream lane. HEARTBEAT-INDEPENDENT-OSCILLATOR-LIVE-009 verifies the running oscillator afterward and is not a startup prerequisite.

completion.next_authorized_action: On the admitted resident StegVerse host, run python scripts/install_sovereign_heartbeat_carrier.py directly. Do not wait for WorkerCoordinator, LIVE-009, GitHub Actions, or any third-party service. When carrier_active=true, run LIVE-009 only as post-start verification and advance WorkerCoordinator separately.
